set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Scheduling puzzle

Eight persons — Aarav, Gopal, Kavya, Mohan, Nikhil, Tarun, Usha and Zoya — have lectures on four consecutive days of a week — Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday — in two sessions each day: morning and evening. 11. Only one person has a lecture between Zoya and Tarun, and Tarun has a lecture before Zoya.
12. The one who teaches Hindi is from Chennai.
13. Zoya teaches English.
14. The one who is from Pune has a lecture on Wednesday.
15. Only three persons have lectures between the one who teaches Economics and the one who teaches English.
16. Gopal is from Kolkata.
17. The one who teaches Economics is not from Mumbai.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Scheduling puzzle
set.stimulus:
Seven persons — Anjali, Meera, Pooja, Tanvi, Uday, Vikram and Zubin — have lectures on different days of the same week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday. Only one lecture is held on each day. Each of them is from a different city — Ranchi, Mumbai, Kochi, Patna, Nagpur, Jaipur and Indore. Each of them teaches a different subject — Hindi, Economics, Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Physics and Sanskrit.

1. As many persons have lectures before Anjali as after Tanvi.
2. Tanvi is from Indore.
3. More than four persons have lectures after the one who is from Nagpur.
4. Neither the one who teaches Hindi nor Zubin has a lecture on Sunday.
5. Only five persons have lectures between the one who is from Patna and the one who teaches Chemistry.
6. The one who teaches Biology has a lecture immediately after the one who teaches Maths.
7. Only three persons have lectures between Pooja and the one who teaches Sanskrit.
8. As many persons have lectures before Pooja as after Zubin.
9. Less than three persons have lectures between the one who is from Jaipur and Uday.
10. Meera is from Kochi.
11. Only two persons have lectures between the one who is from Nagpur and Meera.
12. Vikram has a lecture immediately after Anjali.
13. Vikram is from Mumbai.
14. The one who is from Mumbai teaches Economics.

set.subject: reasoning
set.title: Scheduling puzzle

5. Only one person has a lecture between K and L.

8. Only three persons have lectures between O and the one who teaches Economics.

11. As many persons have lectures before J as after the one who teaches Geography.

13. The one who teaches Economics is from Shimla.
14. Neither the one who teaches Biology nor M has a lecture on Monday.
15. At least one person has a lecture between M and the one who teaches Biology.
16. The one who teaches Physics is from Bhopal.
17. Only three persons have lectures between the one who is from Mumbai and the one who teaches Economics.
18. Less than four persons have lectures between the one who teaches Accounts and P.
